Executive Director

Mrs Alice I. Jackson

Executive Director | Business Management & Healthcare

Alice Iniobong Jackson is a business and administrative professional with experience spanning human resource management, organisational administration, marketing, field research, financial administration and healthcare. She is the Executive Director of Alini Investments Limited. Her professional background combines practical business-management experience with a substantial career in nursing and clinical care.

Her management experience includes serving as Human Resource Manager at Alini Investments Limited from 2010 to 2017, where she oversaw departmental functions and managed key workforce activities, including recruitment and selection, compensation and benefits, training and development, and employee relations. Earlier roles in financial services, research, public-sector administration and private enterprise broadened her experience in customer relationships, field operations, reporting, bookkeeping, payroll and production coordination.

Alongside her business and administrative career, Alice is a Registered Nurse with experience in medical-surgical, emergency and intensive care settings. Her healthcare work has involved patient assessment and monitoring, treatment and medication administration, emergency response, wound care, infection prevention, patient education and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams. This combined background gives her experience across both organisational and clinical environments.

Business, management & administration

  • Executive Director, Alini Investments Limited (Current). Provides executive leadership to the company, drawing on experience in human resource management, administration and organisational coordination.
  • Human Resource Manager, Alini Investments Limited, EPZ, Calabar (2010–2017). Oversaw departmental functions; managed compensation and benefits, training and development, and employee relations; took part in recruitment and selection.
  • Field Research Officer, Cross River State Tourism Bureau / NEXTON (2009). Helped develop research methodologies relating to the Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC) and interviewed members of the public across Local Government Areas to prepare findings for statistical purposes.
  • Marketing Officer, Akin Micro Finance Bank / Rowconsult International, Calabar (2008). Supported new account acquisition, promoted products and services, and maintained relationships with existing accounts.
  • NYSC, Home Finance Department, Ministry of Finance Headquarters, Abuja (2002). Maintained basic accounting records and assisted with staff welfare.
  • Administrative Officer II, Seaward Ventures Nigeria Limited, Calabar (1997). Bookkeeping and administrative duties, production coordination, and payroll preparation and wage disbursement.

Healthcare & nursing

  • Senior Staff Nurse, Premier International School, Wuse, Abuja (2023–2026). Nursing care in accident and emergency, medical and intensive-care settings; monitors patients, administers prescribed medication and treatments, provides wound care, responds to emergencies including CPR, and gives health education to patients and families.
  • Staff Nurse, Joemede Clinic & Maternity, Cross River State (2017–2023). Medical-surgical, intensive-care and maternity nursing, including prenatal, postnatal and neonatal care; administered IV medications and supported discharge planning and follow-up.
  • Staff Nurse, Melfon Clinics, Abuja (2015–2017). Medical-surgical nursing care, wound care, infection control and emergency response, and patient education on chronic disease management.

Education, registration & development

  • HND, Post-Basic Nursing, School of Nursing & Midwifery, Calabar, Cross River State (2022)
  • Registered Nurse (RN), Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN)
  • Registered Nurse (RN), Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC), United Kingdom (2024)
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) (2023)
  • ECG Interpretation and Emergency Response Training (2023)
  • Medication Administration and Management (2023)
  • Safeguarding Adults (Levels 1 and 2) and Preventing Radicalisation (2023)
  • Care Certificate Standards (1–15) (2024)
  • School of Nursing and Midwifery (2023)
  • Saint Monica University (2025)

Community service

  • Participated in and led a free medical and surgical mission that provided care to more than 500 underserved patients (2023).
  • Took part in the Nsit Ubium USA/UDA Free Community Health Programme, including more than 100 patient screenings.

Software Engineer

Mr Khalfani I. Jackson

Khalfani is a Software Engineering student at Cosmopolitan University with practical experience in web development, IT support and workplace operations through internships at the Nigeria Export Processing Zones Authority (NEPZA), the Federal Housing Authority (FHA) and the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation (OSGF). He is familiar with building web interfaces and database-backed applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, PHP and MySQL, alongside UI/UX designs.

His technical experience includes workstation setup, basic network troubleshooting, website review and exposure to server-room operations. He is a proactive problem-solver who communicates clearly, learns quickly and works well with others.

Experience

  • IT Placement Student, Nigeria Export Processing Zones Authority (NEPZA), Abuja (20 July – 5 October 2026). Supported routine IT operations, including operating system installation and workstation setup; assisted with RJ45 connections and Wi-Fi troubleshooting; took part in a review of the organisation’s website; observed server-room operations; and delivered a presentation on artificial intelligence.
  • Intern, Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation (OSGF), Abuja (October – November 2025). Assisted with office operations, data entry, document preparation and organised record-keeping, following workplace procedures and professional standards.
  • Intern, Federal Housing Authority (FHA), Abuja (7 July – 25 August 2025). Supported departmental activities and general administrative tasks, and helped prepare and organise documents and records with accuracy and confidentiality.

Technical skills

  • Programming & web: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, HTML, CSS, React
  • Databases & backend: MySQL, Supabase, PHP, XAMPP
  • Design & prototyping: Figma, Canva, UI/UX design, responsive layout design
  • Tools & platforms: Git, GitHub, Visual Studio Code, Microsoft Office, Notion, Lovable AI
  • IT support: operating system installation, basic hardware and connectivity troubleshooting, RJ45 cable termination, Wi-Fi setup, website auditing

Education, leadership & achievements

  • BSc Software Engineering, Cosmopolitan University, Abuja (2022 – present; expected 2027). Interests: full-stack development, mobile engineering, embedded systems, site reliability engineering and AI-assisted development.
  • General Secretary, Cosmopolitan University

Operations Manager

Engr. E. John Maxwell

Chemical & Process Engineer

Engr. E. John Maxwell is a chemical and process engineer with extensive experience across front-end engineering design (FEED), process safety and regulatory technical review in Nigeria’s oil and gas sector. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Chemical Engineering from the University of Abuja and is pursuing a Master of Engineering in the same field.

At AIL, he supports client engagements through operations management and regulatory liaison. He has managed liaison with OGFZA for a Free Zone Enterprise registration supporting a 10-hectare industrial land allocation, drafted application documents and proposals, and prepared client presentations for regulatory meetings.

  • General Health, Safety and Environment (GHSE 1 & 2) and HSE Level 3, Institute of Safety Professionals of Nigeria (ISPON).
